description: Black Forest Labs' FLUX 2 Pro: photoreal images with strong prompt following, from 0.5 to 4 megapixels. Text-to-image. Compared with other image tools: mid-priced. Price: from $0.032 per image, charged only on success. Price depends on resolution: 0.5 MP $0.032, 1 MP $0.042, 2 MP $0.062, 4 MP $0.103 (default 1 MP). One call = one image.

resolution.description: Output size in megapixels; sets the price. Default 1 MP
